items.request: NEW NEW YORK CITY concept instead of the rejected separate torch and crown. ONE compact BROOKLYN-BRIDGE-LIKE SUSPENSION BRIDGE in front view: TWO broad stone towers, each with ONE large pointed Gothic arch opening, joined by ONE thick shallow curved suspension cable and ONE continuous broad roadway. Behind the roadway, ONE simple STEPPED SKYSCRAPER with a stout centered SPIRE rises between the towers, recalling Manhattan. Only TWO broad diagonal suspension struts on each side, no thin cable mesh, tiny windows, book, torch, crown, lettering, logos, skyline clutter or texture. A sober compact city-and-bridge silhouette that reads at 16 px.
